This is the original printed text (version 1 of 3). The current text is [[Theron Nett (V) (Remastered)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee Virtual Set 4 preview<ref name="eh1351-theron-0">Players Committee, [https://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual-set-4-preview-now-legal/ Virtual Set 4 Preview – Now Legal!] ([https://web.archive.org/web/20160608162046id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/wp/virtual-set-4-preview-now-legal/ preserved 2016 copy]), 4 May 2016.</ref>. First published 4 May 2016. Text: “[Pilot] 2. While at a battleground system, opponent's starships may not 'cloak.' May lose 1 Force to cancel a just-drawn weapon destiny targeting a starship he is piloting.” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Theron Nett (V)]]): Players Committee Appendix A replacement, effective the same day<ref name="eh1351-theron-1">Players Committee Rules, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1047674#p1047674 Appendix A replacement for Theron Nett (V)], published and effective 17 July 2016.</ref>. First published 17 July 2016. The E-marked slip is in the PC Master List captured 6 August 2016. Text: “[Pilot] 2. While at a battleground system, opponent's starships may not 'cloak.' May lose 1 Force (free if piloting Red 10) to cancel a just-drawn weapon destiny targeting a starship he is piloting.” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “(free if piloting Red 10)”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Theron Nett (V) (Remastered)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-theron-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/theronnett.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 commit e8445f0] (1 June 2022).</ref>. First published 1 June 2022. Text: “[Pilot] 2. While at a battleground system, opponent's starships may not 'cloak.' May lose 1 Force (free if piloting Red 10) to cancel a just-drawn weapon destiny targeting a starship he is piloting.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”); the margin title lost its uniqueness dot. It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.
